Class LinkageGraphCSVWriter

java.lang.Object
readWrite.LinkageGraphCSVWriter
public class LinkageGraphCSVWriter extends Object
CSV writer for linkageGraph edges. Will typically be invoked to export multiple graphs

    • writeEdgesToFile

      public void writeEdgesToFile(String directory, String edgeFileName, org.jgrapht.opt.graph.sparse.SparseIntUndirectedWeightedGraph linkageGraph, int[] whichComponent)
      Writes linkage-graph edges to CSV with component labels and rounded weights.
      Parameters:
      directory - where file is to be placed
      edgeFileName - name of edge file
      linkageGraph - graph whose edges will be written to file, with Integer vertices
      whichComponent - gives the component number to which source vertex of an edge belongs.

    • writeSingletonVerticesToFile

      public void writeSingletonVerticesToFile(String directory, String singleVertexFileName, org.jgrapht.opt.graph.sparse.SparseIntUndirectedWeightedGraph linkageGraph, boolean[] isIsolated)
      Writes isolated vertices (singletons) to a one-column CSV file.
      Parameters:
      directory - to write file
      singleVertexFileName - name for file of isolated vertices
      linkageGraph - subgraph on which components are comnputed
      isIsolated - array: true at v if vertex v is isolated
